title: From access to judgement
text: India has over a billion internet users, but only 18% of adults can file a cybercrime complaint online. As generative AI makes fakes cheap, 'the question is no longer how to access information, but how to judge what is reliable'. Children meet AI-shaped feeds before they can question them.
use: For 'A well-educated mind will always have more questions than answers' (2026) and 'Biased media is a real threat to Indian democracy' (2019).

title: Lycurgus Cup and Roman concrete: the science in 'magic'
text: A 1,600-year-old Roman cup glows red in normal light and green when lit from behind. Scientists have only now reverse-engineered it. Roman concrete is still not fully recreated, and Indus Valley drainage still has lessons for cities. The editorial argues that the past's real magic is useful achievement, not myths of flying chariots.
use: For 'magical in the mundane', 'The doubter is a true man of science' (versus pseudo-history) and 'Culture is what we are, civilisation is what we have'.
